why_needed: Short peptides can score well on irrelevant protein surfaces; target class determines meaningful binding region
claim_boundary: Region match is pose plausibility evidence, not affinity proof
next_action: define expected_binding_region field in future parser contract

why_needed: Peptides have N-to-C direction; reversed orientation can invalidate substrate/motif/hotspot interpretation
claim_boundary: Orientation supports mechanism plausibility only when motif context is known
next_action: add terminal_orientation_status to future pose-quality schema

why_needed: Key peptide residues should align with target pockets or hotspots; interaction counts alone are insufficient
claim_boundary: Hydrogen-bond count alone must not be written as strong mechanism evidence
next_action: record key residues in target/control metadata before scoring

why_needed: Flexible peptides may produce strained or unanchored poses with attractive docking scores
claim_boundary: Pose plausibility is planned parser/manual-QC evidence, not completed result
next_action: define parser/manual review rubric for strain/clash/anchor clarity

why_needed: Length, net charge, structure source and software parameters affect docking score comparability
claim_boundary: Cross-length or cross-charge ranking should be interpreted as uncalibrated
next_action: add comparability group to future ranking tables

why_needed: Cyclic peptides differ by head-to-tail, sidechain, disulfide, thioether and mixed cyclization modes
claim_boundary: cyclic=yes is insufficient for topology-aware evaluation
next_action: extend metadata with cyclization_mode when target set is frozen

why_needed: D-peptide and heterochiral outputs require stereochemistry-aware parsing and scoring applicability flags
claim_boundary: D/L flag is not proof that scoring functions are valid for D-peptides

why_needed: ncAA, N-methylation and backbone modifications require explicit representation such as HELM or CHUCKLES
claim_boundary: Representation support is parser evidence, not clinical developability evidence
next_action: define representation_scheme field for future ncAA extensions

why_needed: Binding score does not capture charge, hydrophobicity, aggregation risk, permeability or synthesis complexity
claim_boundary: Metadata proxies must not be written as measured solubility or stability
next_action: keep experimental developability fields blank unless measured

why_needed: Flow matching explains a generative model family but does not prove specific peptide method availability
claim_boundary: Paradigm labels cannot substitute for source pin, license or smoke-test evidence
